zh.title: A380新創航空Global Airlines遭英國法院下令強制清算　唯一客機仍停放法國
zh.summary: 英國法院11月4日對Global Airlines發出強制清算令，12日正式公告；這家以A380跨大西洋航線為目標的新創業者，曾短暫執行4個載客航段。
body: 英國航空新創公司Global Airlines遭法院下令強制清算。根據英國官方公示刊物《The London Gazette》11月12日發布的通知，英國高等法院於2026年11月4日對Global Airlines Ltd（公司編號13508008）發出清算令，並指派官方接管人處理相關程序。這項裁定源自今年5月29日提出的清算聲請，使公司以空中巴士A380重返跨大西洋市場的計畫面臨重大轉折。

Global Airlines由James Asquith於2021年創立，以大型雙層客機、較高規格的客艙服務與英美航線為營運訴求。公司雖然曾提出多架A380的機隊構想，始終未取得自己的航空營運許可（AOC）。2025年5月，Global Airlines曾透過Hi Fly Malta濕租執飛英國與美國紐約之間的載客服務；根據Flightradar24統計，當時共完成4個載客航段，未發展為持續運作的定期航線。
Global Airlines唯一已取得的A380註冊編號為9H-GLOBL，原先由中國南方航空營運，2025年7月起停放在法國塔布機場。法院發出清算令後，公司資產及債務將依司法與清算程序處理；這並不直接確定該架A380最終會由誰接手。本文配圖為9H-GLOBL於2025年7月抵達塔布的資料照片，並非清算程序現場。

en.title: UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation; lone A380 remains stored in France
en.summary: A UK High Court winding-up order issued on November 4 against Global Airlines Ltd was published on November 12, while its sole Airbus A380 remains stored at Tarbes.
body: British A380 startup Global Airlines Ltd has been placed into compulsory liquidation by court order. According to a notice published in The London Gazette on November 12, 2026, the High Court of Justice made a winding-up order on November 4, following a petition filed on May 29. An official receiver has been appointed to oversee the process, creating a substantial setback for the company's proposed transatlantic Airbus A380 operations.

Founded in 2021 by James Asquith, Global Airlines aimed to offer premium services between the UK and North America using the double-deck Airbus A380. It never obtained its own air operator certificate. In May 2025, it briefly offered flights between Britain and New York operated on a wet-lease basis by Hi Fly Malta. Flightradar24 reported that four revenue flight sectors were completed, without any subsequent sustained scheduled operation.

The only Airbus A380 acquired by the company, registration 9H-GLOBL, previously flew with China Southern Airlines and has been stored at Tarbes in France since July 2025. The winding-up order initiates a formal legal process to address assets and liabilities; it does not itself establish the aircraft's eventual disposition. The accompanying photograph shows 9H-GLOBL arriving at Tarbes in July 2025, not the 2026 court proceedings.

facts.claim: A UK High Court winding-up order against Global Airlines Ltd was made on November 4 and publicly gazetted on November 12, after a May 29, 2026 petition.
An official receiver was appointed liquidator in the court-ordered compulsory liquidation, company number 13508008.
The airline never held its own air operator certificate and offered four passenger flight sectors between the UK and New York in May 2025, operated by Hi Fly Malta.
The Global Airlines Airbus A380 9H-GLOBL has been in long-term storage at Tarbes, France since July 2025.
